aria: Animated recap of the Pistons' 122 to 111 home win over Washington: Duncan Robinson's drive with 8:14 left for a 19-point lead, quarter-by-quarter scoring, John Collins' season-high 24 points and 10 rebounds, the top scorers, how the Pistons won, and the next game at Washington.
notes: Box score from the Pistons' 122–111 home win over the Washington Wizards on Nov 9, 2026, from Covers.com's game overview (quarter scores, every player's line, fast-break points, points in the paint, assists, free throws and biggest leads). All 122 Pistons points and all 111 Wizards points are accounted for in the box score, and the quarter scores add up to both totals. Game details from the AP (via CBS News Detroit and FOX Sports), Field Level Media (via 92.1 The Ticket), MLive (via Yahoo Sports) and Roundtable Sports (via Yahoo Sports). The sports data feed wasn't available for this recap.

Halftime was 68–58, with Collins on 15 (Field Level Media, MLive). Biggest leads: Detroit's 19 and Washington's 1 (Covers.com). Washington turned it over 18 times to Detroit's 10, and Detroit had 19 fast-break points to Washington's 4 (Covers.com). Five Pistons scored in double figures (box score). Daniss Jenkins scored 13 in the third quarter (AP) in his second start of the season (MLive). Collins' 24 was a season high, and the win ended Detroit's first losing streak of the season (MLive). Anthony Davis scored 44 with 13 rebounds for Washington, 30 of them in the first half (AP, Covers.com). Washington has lost four straight (AP) and seven of its last nine meetings with Detroit (Field Level Media). The Pistons are 7–3 (the site's 6–3 plus this win) and play at Washington on Thursday at 7:00 PM ET (AP; time from Sportbusy's listing).

The play of the game is an original illustration of Duncan Robinson's drive with 8:14 left that made it 110–91 (Field Level Media), Detroit's 19-point biggest lead (Covers.com). It is drawn as a basket on a drive from 108–91; the recaps don't describe the finish. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Detroit Pistons or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The player in the play of the game is drawn to Robinson’s listed 6-foot-7 and 215 pounds (RealGM), wearing No. 55 (RealGM), in the Pistons' home kit. No wingspan is reported, so his arms are drawn to his height. He isn't in the site's looks file yet, so he is a team-colour silhouette in the kit. It is an original figure with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
